# Yulan Galagoda

> Cybersecurity engineer and AI researcher specialising in intrusion detection systems for connected vehicles. Based in Plymouth, UK. Available for collaborations and consultations in IoV security, adversarial ML, and IDS evaluation.

## About

Yulan Galagoda (YG) works at the intersection of cybersecurity and machine learning. BSc Computer Security (First Class), University of Plymouth. MSc Artificial Intelligence in progress — dissertation investigates adversarial training for deep-learning intrusion detection on the Controller Area Network (CAN bus) using the CICIoV2024 dataset and the Adversarial Robustness Toolbox.

Previously: Cyber Security Engineer Executive at Union Assurance PLC; Associate Engineer at Lanka Communication Services.

## Projects

- **AdverSec** — Hardening neural IDS against FGSM and PGD attacks on the CAN bus (MSc dissertation, in progress, 2025)
- **NetEAGLE** — Raspberry Pi network security gateway combining a Flask REST API, companion mobile app, Nmap, UFW and Suricata IDPS into a single device for non-technical users (BSc dissertation, First Class, 2024)
- **The Meridian** — Personal digital reliquary: curated catalogue of antiques and historical objects with provenance, condition and valuation notes
- **Rampe** — Sri Lankan and global recipe archive, schema-first and Notion-backed
